info.title: MovieUniverse Hub API
info.description: Local session-based API. Fetch /api/auth/session first; send its csrfToken in csrfHeader for every mutation, including login/register. Fetch a fresh token after login/logout. All supplied userId values must match the authenticated session. Movie endpoints require login; scores are aggregates; own rating requires a matching session.
